Dates must come from the article body, not a listing page: FAS listing pages mis-attribute dates. `time` is optional and Asia/Singapore — state it only when the source does; never invent one. Validated by checks/news-audit.mjs on every push.

items.title: FAS Congress reviews the year: women's team progress, doubled SPL prize pool
items.summary: At its Congress at Shangri-La Singapore, FAS President Forrest Li and the Council reviewed the past year with member clubs and stakeholders from FIFA, the AFC, AFF, SportSG and Unleash The Roar!. Cited highlights included the Women's National Team's third-place finish at the AFF Women's Cup and its qualification for the 2027 ASEAN Women's Championship under new head coach Mihoko Ishida, all Women's Premier League matches being live-streamed for the first time, and a doubling of the SPL prize pool. No new youth-fee, academy-licensing or pathway policy was announced at the Congress itself.

items.title: Lions open FIFA ASEAN Cup 2026 with 2-0 defeat to hosts Indonesia
items.summary: Singapore lost 2-0 to co-hosts Indonesia in their Division 1 Group A opener at Gelora Bung Karno Stadium in Jakarta. Ragnar Oratmangoen put Indonesia ahead in the 13th minute and Ole Romeny added a 74th-minute penalty after Safuwan Baharudin was sent off for Singapore in the 70th minute. The Lions, who reached the semi-finals of July's ASEAN Championship Hyundai Cup, continue their group campaign against Bangladesh and Malaysia.

items.title: Gavin Lee names a 25-man Lions squad for the ASEAN Hyundai Cup 2026
items.summary: Head coach Gavin Lee confirmed the 25 players representing Singapore at the ASEAN Championship Hyundai Cup 2026, which runs from 24 July to 26 August. The Lions open their Group A campaign away to Cambodia in Phnom Penh on Friday 24 July, return home to face Timor-Leste on 27 July, then travel to defending champions Vietnam on 31 July.

items.title: Tickets released for Singapore's ASEAN Hyundai Cup home fixtures at Jalan Besar Stadium
items.summary: FAS put tickets for the Lions' home Group A fixture against Timor-Leste on sale at 11am, with tickets for the 7 August home fixture against Indonesia following on Wednesday 22 July, also at 11am. Both fixtures are at Jalan Besar Stadium.
